# Synthetic tray trial A

Author: Aster Desk Lab (fictional organization).
Published: 2026-09-01. Captured: 2026-09-24.
Identity: aster-tray-a-v1. Entirely invented test material.

## Measurements

For one tray cooling trial at a nominal 22 C room temperature, the open vent
reached the target in 18 minutes; the closed vent took 24 minutes.

## Recommendation

For this nominal setup, we recommend the open vent. This is a single trial,
not evidence of a general advantage. No humidity measurement was recorded.
